text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober, do you have a moment? Have 
you happened to see Ramonu anywhere?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ramonu-san...? If I recall... she was 
supposed to be painting in the courtyard 
today, but—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ah! Kaichooo~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! Let's do some tandem training 
together later! Please, please, 
pleeease~!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, very well. I accept your challenge. 
I shall call for you once my duties are 
finished. Warm up and wait for me.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay! I'll be all warmed up and waiting 
for ya!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Teio can just ask so easily... She can 
tell the person she looks up to that she 
wants to run together...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (Whereas I...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: What is it, Rudolf?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It is regarding your solo exhibition. 
You've heard about it, haven't you? The 
Symboli family is also sponsoring it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Ramonu-san is holding a solo 
exhibition...!?)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hosting an exhibition requires a great 
deal of manpower. We've been vetting 
support staff, but finding someone who 
might meet your discerning eye has proven 
difficult—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
U-Um!! If you don't mind... please let me 
help!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(I want to invite Ramonu-san to run tandem 
with me... Naturally, casually, straight 
from the heart, just like when Teio asks 
the President...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(If I help out with her exhibition, surely 
I'll find a chance...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I finished designing the invitation cards. 
Um, could you take a look at them for a 
second?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I leave it in your hands.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On my way to the trainer's room, I spotted 
Mejiro Dober and Mejiro Ramonu. They 
seemed to be discussing the solo 
exhibition I'd heard rumors about.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I gathered the paintings you made at the 
academy into that empty classroom over 
there for now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'll personally oversee the transport of 
the artwork, so...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I see. I shall leave the rest to you, 
then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yes! And, um... er... ...U-Um...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —Is there something else?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
If you have no further business, excuse 
me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
............Haaah. I couldn't say it 
again...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober looked visibly dejected. It 
seemed like there was something she 
desperately wanted to tell Ramonu. I 
thought I heard her start to say "tan" 
earlier, but...
choice_data_list:
Is there something you want to say to 
Ramonu?

Is there something you want to say to 
Ramonu?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Gk! ...Not really...
choice_data_list:
Like wanting to do tandem training with 
Ramonu...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Still... There's no way someone like me 
could ask—
choice_data_list:
Is it because you feel you're no match for 
her?
When you have such a great opportunity...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah... With how I am right now, I 
just...
choice_data_list:
Is it because you feel you're no match for 
her?
When you have such a great opportunity...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I know full well the difference in our 
abilities, of course, but... it's 
something even before that, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Not just skill, but even when it comes to 
raw passion... So for me to say "please 
run with me"...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Besides... whenever I look at Ramonu-san's 
paintings, it makes me realize all over 
again how different our leagues are...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That overwhelming love for racing... The 
sheer intensity of her feelings is on an 
entirely different level from mine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Until I possess a resolve strong enough 
not to lose to that... I just can't say 
it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
There are so many girls who admire 
Ramonu-san... I'm not the only one.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Expecting her to give me her time with 
just that alone... feels like something 
crucial is missing...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Though what that missing "something" is... 
I still don't really know...
